candidate_classification: 几何连接成立的结构概念候选

measurement_method.method: Actual BRep Boolean common intersections with 0.01 mm horizontal slabs restricted to the exact bridge XY box; compute absolute volume using BRepGProp.VolumeProperties and divide by slab height. The overlap volume divided by the 0.5 mm overlap depth gives the nominal projected footprint. This is a geometric footprint, not a mechanically validated effective load-bearing area.

engineering_judgment.half_mm_interpretation: 0.5 mm is the Boolean penetration depth into the existing B top surface. It does not by itself mean the final one-piece part has an isolated 0.5 mm thick structural neck. The B material at the same projected footprint continues through its 6 mm thickness.
engineering_judgment.root_status: The 16.3644 mm2 geometric bridge-foot projection is only about 45.46% of the 36 mm2 bridge section and is spatially confined at the B outer edge. Together with the approximately 36.41 mm bridge span and absent fillets/ribs, this is insufficient evidence of strength or stiffness. Do not describe it as a demonstrated load-capable optimization.
engineering_judgment.recommended_next_design_work: Expand the bridge-foot projection into B, improve fillets or ribs and the transition into 7007, then verify loads, stiffness and fatigue. Merely increasing Z penetration depth does not automatically enlarge the current projected footprint or resolve the stress concentration. Any geometry enlargement needs a fresh motor, 7017 stop-column, fastener, motion and assembly clearance check.
engineering_judgment.changed_load_path: Removing the three front-shell fasteners moves the shell-to-thigh load path through the four retained rear fasteners, B and the new bridge. Rear fastener capacity, bridge bending/torsion and motor alignment have not been validated.

remaining_limits: No forces, torques, duty cycle, impact load, material allowables, boundary conditions or fastener preload were assigned.
No FEA, strength, stiffness, fatigue, tolerance, stress concentration, manufacturability or complete motion audit was performed.
The projected footprint is a geometric descriptor and must not be used as a verified allowable load area.

The clear diameter-46.3 cylindrical column only addresses that envelope against this integrated structure; it does not validate the real motor rear projections, rear screw disengagement, tools, wiring or full assembly/disassembly sequence.
Only the right-rear representative candidate exists. No formal R4 parts were changed and the confirmed formal net reduction remains zero.
